entities.summary: Brett Kulak is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Colorado Avalanche of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected in the fourth round, 105th overall, by the Calgary Flames in the 2012 NHL entry draft. Kulak has also previously played for the Montreal Canadiens, Edmonton Oilers, and Pittsburgh Penguins.
